About Me

Technology Professional • Insurance Advisor • Lifelong Learner

Who I Am

Hello, I'm Santanu Mukherjee.

I have spent nearly three decades in Information Technology, gaining experience in software, problem solving and continuous learning.

Alongside technology, I have chosen to work as an Insurance Advisor because financial protection is one of the meaningful ways to serve people.

Santanu's Space brings together Technology, Insurance and Learning with a commitment to lifelong growth.

My Journey

Technology taught me structured thinking.

Insurance taught me the importance of understanding people's needs.

Learning taught me that growth never ends.

Why Insurance

Insurance is not simply about policies.

It is about protecting families, planning for the future, and creating financial confidence.

My goal is to help people understand before they decide.

Why Technology

Technology is constantly changing. Learning never stops.

My IT background helps me approach challenges with curiosity, discipline and structured thinking.

Core Values

Trust

Knowledge

Lifelong Learning

My Mission

To combine technology, financial awareness and continuous learning to create meaningful value for people and society.
